integrity: A self-contained all-dimension proof and a finite, exact/decimal reproducibility checker are supplied. External independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for all n>=3 (two-level obstruction) and n>=100 divisible by 20 (three-level existence), not all dimensions. Does not optimize point count or noisy stability; finite numerical checks are supplementary. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Three-amplitude signed-permutation Parseval frames for spherical cubics
